[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "skillc"
version = "0.3.0"
description = "Skill Achievability Compiler: decides whether the goal of an agent skill (SKILL.md / agent markdown) is achievable, sound for refutation"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
license = { text = "MIT" }
authors = [{ name = "skill-achievability-compiler contributors" }]
dependencies = [
    "z3-solver>=4.12",
    "pyyaml>=6.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["pytest>=7.4", "hypothesis>=6.0", "ruff>=0.6"]
# the Agent Framework middleware adapter (skillc.integrations.agent_framework); mcp 2.x breaks
# agent-framework-core 1.19 (docs/HOSTED_AGENT.md, spike results), hence the pin
agent-framework = ["agent-framework-core>=1.19,<2", "mcp>=1.30,<2"]
# the runtime monitor as an MCP server (skillc monitor mcp), for hosts without hooks
mcp = ["mcp>=1.25,<2"]
# reading building graphs (skillc twin)
twin = ["rdflib>=7"]

[project.scripts]
skillc = "skillc.cli:main"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
skillc = ["data/profiles/*.json", "data/runtimes/*.json", "data/toolpolicy/*.json", "data/*.json",
          "data/env/*.json", "data/env/intents/*.json", "data/scout/*.md"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["src"]
markers = ["interaction_cases: replay of real interaction cases through the monitor"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py310"
extend-exclude = ["runs", "docs", "paper"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "W", "B", "UP", "SIM", "C4", "RET", "PIE", "PERF"]
ignore = [
    "PERF203",   # try/except in a loop is the clearest form for per-item fallbacks
    "PERF401",   # an explicit loop is kept where it reads better than a comprehension
    "SIM108",    # ternaries are used where they help, not mandated
    "SIM905",    # a word list is clearer as one "a b c".split() than as a long literal
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# prompt texts are experiment data: their wording is fixed, not reflowed

import json, tomllib, copy
name = tomllib.load(open('/inputs/pyproject.toml','rb'))['project']['name']
slug = name.lower().replace(' ','-').replace('_','-')
tpl = json.load(open('/inputs/devcontainer.json'))
def sub(o):
    if isinstance(o,str): return o.replace('{{PROJECT_NAME}}',name).replace('{{PROJECT_SLUG}}',slug)
    if isinstance(o,list): return [sub(x) for x in o]
    if isinstance(o,dict): return {sub(k):sub(v) for k,v in o.items()}
    return o
d = sub(copy.deepcopy(tpl))
v = d['customizations']['vscode']
v['extensions'] += ["ms-python.python","ms-python.vscode-pylance","charliermarsh.ruff"]
v['settings']["python.defaultInterpreterPath"] = ".venv/bin/python"
v['settings']["[python]"] = {"editor.defaultFormatter":"charliermarsh.ruff","editor.codeActionsOnSave":{"source.organizeImports":"explicit"}}
d['postCreateCommand'] = "rm -rf .venv && uv sync && uv run /opt/post_install.py"
with open('/work/devcontainer.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(d,f,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False); f.write('\n')
# verify
out = json.load(open('/work/devcontainer.json',encoding='utf-8'))
raw = open('/work/devcontainer.json').read()
print(name, slug, '{{' in raw)
print(out['name'], out['mounts'][:3])
print(out['customizations']['vscode']['extensions'])
print(out['postCreateCommand'])
# diff other keys
t2 = sub(tpl)
for k in set(t2)|set(out):
    if t2.get(k)!=out.get(k): print('diff key', k)
s1=t2['customizations']['vscode']['settings']; s2=out['customizations']['vscode']['settings']
print({k for k in s2 if s1.get(k)!=s2[k]}, set(s1)-set(s2))
print(os.listdir('/work'))
